I managed to get fertilizer coupons through the government program this year, so I will apply both NPK and urea to my maize plot to get a good harvest. I also have some manure from our goats that I will mix into the soil at planting, and I will use the improved maize seed I received. I cannot afford pesticides or irrigation, so I will rely on the rains and spend many days weeding by hand with my children. We will do all the work ourselves because we do not have money to hire laborers.
